item.description:
Info
tl;dr: my script for Claude Code session cache deletion on GitHub.

The lobotomy procedure was awarded the Nobel Prize for Medicine in 1949. Today, its therapeutic value is questionable & it is discredited by medical practitioners. (I guess the Nobel folks don’t get it right 100% of the time.)

Good thing then that the lobotomy I am suggesting is for Claude Code (who as far as I know does not have a real 🧠.)

item.title: Add Search To a Hugo Site With Fuse.js
item.description:
Today I added search on my Hugo static site with Fuse.js. I am unreasonably excited about this for kind of a negative reason:

I’ve had a lot, A LOT of recent experience with a static site that had pretty disappointing search capability.

I found Fuse.js in Blowfish - a really thoughtful & nice looking Hugo theme that I probably would have used for my site if I’d discovered it early.
